children: Private equity firm Advent International LP and FedEx
cleared a threshold for acquiring Polish parcel-locker company inPost SA

The consortium cleared the minimum acceptance threshold of at least 80% of shares tendered for its offer to purchase inPost, according to a Bloomberg report on Friday, which cited an emailed statement. About 89.1% of inPost shares were tendered.
The consortium announced the deal in February and said it would begin a public offer
